title: Turkish-Style Lahmacun
description: Lahmacun is a popular Turkish dish consisting of a thin crust topped with spiced minced meat, onions, and herbs.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C) with a baking stone or baking sheet inside.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal pieces, depending on desired pizza size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Transfer the dough to the preheated stone or baking sheet.
Spread the minced lamb mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the chopped onion and parsley over the lamb mixture.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the meat is cooked through.
